Automate Amazon brand bookkeeping and product images
An Amazon brand operator uses Claude Code to automate as much of his business as possible, including bookkeeping and generating product listing images.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The source mentions this only in passing. Alex Willen buys and operates e-commerce brands on Amazon. He uses Claude Code to automate as much of the business as he can, and the examples given are bookkeeping and generating product images for listings. It gives no setup, tools, steps, or details on where he steps in.
How it went
The source states no results, numbers, or shortcomings for his setup. It only lists him among non-developers using Claude Code for business automation and links to his Substack, The Automated Operator.
Worth knowing
For the actual workflow, read Alex Willen's publication, The Automated Operator. This article is mainly a subagents tutorial and doesn't explain his process.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
I run an Amazon brand and keep my records in [folder path with exported sales reports, fee statements and receipts]. Read the files, categorize each transaction into bookkeeping categories, and produce a monthly profit and loss summary as a spreadsheet for [month]. Then, using the product photos in [image folder] and the key selling points I list here: [selling points], generate a set of listing image concepts or scripts for [product name]. You are done when the spreadsheet and the image set are saved in a new folder and you have listed any transactions you were unsure about. Do not delete or overwrite any of my original files.
Original source: https://aiblewmymind.substack.com/p/claude-code-subagents-explained

translation.body:
自动化亚马逊品牌记账和商品图片制作
一位亚马逊品牌经营者用Claude Code尽可能多地自动化业务，包括记账和为商品详情页生成图片。
使用工具
Claude Code
他们做了什么
来源只是顺带提到这件事。Alex Willen购买并经营亚马逊上的电商品牌。他用Claude Code尽可能自动化业务，给出的例子是记账和生成商品详情页图片。来源没有提供设置、工具、步骤或他在何处介入的细节。
效果如何
来源没有说明其方案的结果、数字或不足。它只是把他列为使用Claude Code进行业务自动化的非开发者之一，并链接到他的Substack刊物The Automated Operator。
值得了解
要了解实际流程，请阅读Alex Willen的刊物The Automated Operator。这篇文章主要是子智能体教程，并未解释他的流程。
亲自试用Claude Code
复制提示词
我经营一个亚马逊品牌，记录保存在[包含导出销售报告、费用报表和收据的文件夹路径]。读取文件，将每笔交易归入记账类别，并为[月份]生成电子表格形式的月度损益摘要。然后，使用[图片文件夹]中的产品照片和我在这里列出的主要卖点：[卖点]，为[产品名称]生成一组商品详情页图片构思或脚本。当电子表格与图片集保存在一个新文件夹，且你列出了所有不确定的交易时，任务完成。不要删除或覆盖任何原始文件。
原始来源：https://aiblewmymind.substack.com/p/claude-code-subagents-explained
